result:
Every evening, the man in the yellow coat walked to the end of the pier and dropped one pebble into the sea.

People invented reasons. He was counting the days since a great love had left him. He was trying to fill the ocean, one stone at a time. He had made a promise to someone who had died.

One afternoon, a child finally asked him.

“The stones are from my garden,” he said. “Every spring, more of them appear.”

“Why bring them here?”

“The tomatoes don’t like them.”

The child considered this. “Does the sea?”

“I haven’t asked.”

The next evening, the child came back with a pebble of her own. They dropped their stones together and listened to the small, separate sounds they made.
